methods.description: Add the indices for products of matching bases, including an implicit index1.
Subtract indices for powers of the same nonzero base.
Combine powers by the matching law and then give a basic numeral when requested.
Identify the applicable operation/base conditions and reject unlike bases for the same-base law.
Use two laws in sequence, including an equal-power quotient producing index0 of a nonzero base.
Apply the ordinary order of operations around valid combinations; evaluate separate bases.
Infer a missing positive index or numerical factor from the product/quotient law and supplied facts.
Simplify nested powers to a common base greater than1, then compare positive indices.
